date: "2026-10-31"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.align = 'center', out.width = '80%')
options(width = 90)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Coffee <- read.csv("Coffee_Fill.csv")
```

```{r}
c(n      = length(Coffee$Weight),
  mean   = round(mean(Coffee$Weight), 2),
  sd     = round(sd(Coffee$Weight), 2),
  median = round(median(Coffee$Weight), 2),
  min    = min(Coffee$Weight),
  max    = max(Coffee$Weight),
  se     = round(sd(Coffee$Weight) / sqrt(length(Coffee$Weight)), 2))
```

```{r}
t.test(Coffee$Weight,
       alternative = "two.sided",
       mu = 340,
       conf.level = 0.95)
```
